summary: IdP nonce/cookie rotation causes token exchange failures for terraform-runner service (intermittent internal CLI errors)
screenshot_or_logs:
auth-service: 2026-03-10T18:42:11Z ERROR token-exchange failed: nonce_mismatch
ssh-proxy: 2026-03-10T18:42:12Z WARN stale-cookie detected for runner-id: tr-09a3
description:
Issue summary:
After the scheduled IdP certificate/nonce rotation on 2026-03-10 18:30 UTC, several terraform-runner workers started returning 401/invalid_grant during token exchange. This prevents CI jobs from provisioning or applying state in prod-us-west.
impact: Multiple CI pipelines using terraform-runner are failing to authenticate; customer-facing services cannot deploy configuration changes. Roughly 8-12 runners affected, ~25% of job throughput reduced in prod-us-west during the window.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger a terraform-runner job that performs state operations using service account token.
2) Observe runner logs during authentication handshake with sso-proxy.
3) Intermittent failures show 'nonce_mismatch' during token-exchange step.
Note: issue correlated with IdP rotation window and is not reproduced outside that window.
diagnostics_and_temporal_pattern:
- Failures spike from 2026-03-10T18:31:00Z to 2026-03-10T18:48:00Z.
- Logs show new cookies from IdP with rotated nonce but some intermediate sso-proxy instances still validate against old nonce index.
- A subset of runners retried successfully after 90s; others required manual restart.
- No TLS errors observed; failures limited to token exchange path (500s/401s).
initial_hypothesis: Race between IdP nonce roll-forward and the sso-proxy in-memory cache of valid nonces. Some sso-proxy replicas used stale nonce validators causing token-exchange to fail if request routed to those pods immediately after rotation.
investigation_notes:
- Support (Aisha) confirmed scope and collected logs, ticket opened.
- Oncall SRE (Carlos) checked sso-proxy deployment: rolling restart was in progress at rotation time due to unrelated config deploy.
- sso-proxy instances show two different accepted-nonce values across replicas when queried.
- Reviewed IdP rotation runbook; runbook expects sticky deployment ordering but that was not honored due to concurrent deploys.
- Reproduced locally by forcing nonce update while half of sso-proxy cluster uses old validators.
- Related issue INT-271001 shows previous oauth refresh edge cases during overlapping rotations.
comments: 2026-03-10 19:02 - Aisha Patel (Support): Customer-impacting; escalated to SRE. See Slack thread #support-idp-rotation.

2026-03-10 19:12 - Carlos Mendes (SRE): Observed mixed nonce state across sso-proxy pods. Temporarily scaling down and back up normalized validators; some runners recovered. Initiating controlled rollout to ensure consistent validator state.

2026-03-10 20:05 - Mira Kovac (Identity): IdP rotation executed as scheduled; we rotated nonce index and published new index. We did not coordinate with sso-proxy rolling update. Adding handshake in runbook to wait for sso-proxy readiness post-rotation.
2026-03-11 09:15 - Carlos Mendes (SRE): Adding config change to sso-proxy to persist nonce history in redis cache to avoid single-replica mismatch. Draft PR linked in related_github_prs.
2026-03-12 11:30 - Aisha Patel (Support): Marking as In Progress while SRE lands mitigation patch. Customers notified of workaround (restart affected runners).
workaround: Restart affected terraform-runner pods (kubectl rollout restart) or temporarily scale down/up sso-proxy to force validator refresh. Runners that were restarted recovered and reauthenticated within ~30-90s.
resolution:
Mitigation: sso-proxy patched to persist nonce history in Redis and to accept last N nonce indices for 2 minutes post-rotation. Runbook updated to pause unrelated sso-proxy deploys during IdP rotations. Patch deployed 2026-03-12 08:40 UTC to prod-us-west.
Follow-up: schedule a dry-run of rotation with SRE and Identity team. Postmortem draft created in Confluence.
fix_release_notes: sso-proxy v1.14.2: nonce-history persistence to redis; accept last 2 nonce indices for 120s; added readiness gating during IdP rotations.
next_steps:
1) Runbook update merged and published.
2) Coordinate rotation windows with SRE via scheduled maintenance calendar.
3) Add integration test to rotation test harness.
4) Notify Platform teams of new sso-proxy behavior.
resolution_status: Mitigated in prod; monitoring in place for two rotations to validate durability
